title: Shadow passes lack a declared camera pixel footprint
body: R716's exact last step needs each ray's pixel footprint. The primary march gets it from RaySizeCoefNode, but the shadow wave's push block carries the hand-set secondary LOD coefficient (0.05, VIXEN_SECONDARY_RAY_SIZE_COEF) and had no camera fov/aspect. Lane vixenartifacts2 wired fov/aspect in BuildRenderGraph and derives the cone in ShadowVisibilityWave as 2*tan(fov/rows/2) with rows = sqrt(records/aspect). A declared per-pixel footprint input (derived by the scheduler, R674) should replace both the in-shader derivation and the hand-wired push fields. Tier luna: several files, one graph seam, measurable with the traversal capture harness.

title: A/B shader captures need a per-run shader source override
body: The app compiles shaders at runtime from the compile-time VIXEN_SHADER_SOURCE_DIR. A before/after capture therefore has to swap tracked shader files in the worktree, which silently changes what any concurrently running GPU test or capture in that tree loads (lane vixenartifacts2 had to serialize its base-shader captures behind its own GPU suite). An env override for the shader source dir (validated, logged) would make A/B runs safe. Tier haiku: one getenv in the shader-path resolution plus a log line.

title: HitRecord snapshot readback is copied between capture harnesses
body: test_traversal_capture.cpp (lane vixenartifacts2) repeats test_lookdev_capture.cpp's HitRecord snapshot: host buffer allocation, post-dispatch copy with barriers, PreCleanup release, map and dump (about 70 lines). Extract one test helper (e.g. a HitRecordSnapshot class in the application test support) and use it from both. Tier haiku: mechanical extraction with two callers.

title: Analytic shadow visibility is one bit, so cast-shadow edges cannot be footprint-filtered
body: After R716 the blob's cast shadow on the left sphere is correct but still a hard 1-pixel staircase: ShadowVisibilityWave stores one visibility bit per light. The procedural march already knows the closest-approach gap minus footprint along the shadow ray, which would give a pixel-scale filtered edge that keeps the hard cel look. That needs a fractional visibility representation in the HitRecord word and in the shade pass. Design question for the owner: is a filtered shadow edge wanted for the cel look, and where does fractional visibility live?

title: Generated HLSL recipe kernels fail to parse on the WSL base
body: On base 96196995 (and unchanged on lane vixenartifacts2), 10 GPU ProceduralRecipeRenderTest cases and 11 CPU tests (HlslIngestion.GeneratedKernelsCompileToSpirv, RecipeCodegen/SdfRecipeCodegen/CodegenEmit *CompilesToSpirv) fail with 'shader:6: ) : Expected ... HLSL parsing failed' at column 57. MEASURED base: the GPU set reran red with base shaders; the CPU binaries depend on no lane-changed file (ninja deps). Tier luna: one emitter defect behind many reds, needs locating the emitted line 6.

title: HeadlessUiGraph fails Prepare when FSR3 is off
body: HeadlessUiGraph.RendersAndReadsBackAnOffscreenFrame fails on the WSL VIXEN_WITH_FSR3=OFF build with 'Compiled upscaler provider is absent from its candidate set' in VulkanGraphApplication::Prepare, on base shaders too (MEASURED, lane vixenartifacts2). The headless UI fixture should select a compiled upscaler or the candidate set should drop absent providers. Tier haiku: one fixture or selection default.

title: AppFlowBlob.InteriorEditPreservesShapeHash is red on the WSL base
body: CPU test AppFlowBlob.InteriorEditPreservesShapeHash fails (test_appflow_blob.cpp:132, 13 vs 2) on lane vixenartifacts2; its binary depends on no lane-changed file (ninja deps), so the red is the base's. Tier haiku: one assertion to re-baseline or one hash input to fix.
